text: キクコは　わかい　とき　オーキドはかせと　ライバルで　つよさを　きそって　いたらしい！

structure.jp: オーキドはかせと　ライバルで
structure.en: was a rival of Professor Oak, and

structure.jp: つよさを　きそって　いたらしい！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows something going on over a stretch of time; with いた it was going on in the past. きそって　いた = 'were competing'.

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい at the end says this is what you've heard, not what you know first-hand. きそって　いたらしい = 'apparently they were competing'.

patterns.name: 〜で (linking)
patterns.explanation: で here is the 'and' form of だ, joining 'was a rival' to what follows. ライバルで = 'was a rival, and'.
